label_provenance: agent-authored static extraction, frozen before model analysis

decisions.target: Export createAspect and the public Aspect type.
Flatten nested aspects, deduplicate underlying traits by identity, retain first occurrence order, and require at least two unique traits after flattening.
Reject relation constituents and overlapping data schema field names at creation time.
Accept tags and merge schema fields from data constituents; tags contribute no fields.
Every call returns a fresh instance with a distinct numeric ID.
Expose non-reassignable id/traits/schema; freeze traits and schema at the top level, retaining nested schema references.
An aspect is callable with optional initial field values and the configured result is accepted by entity.add; bare aspect addition uses defaults.
has requires every constituent; get returns undefined if any is missing; otherwise merge data fields, omit tag data, and return an empty object for a complete tag-only aspect.
Return a new shallow merged object: top-level assignments do not write back; nested object/array references are shared, not deeply cloned.
If any constituent is missing, perform no writes and no notifications.
Route supplied schema fields to their owners, ignore unknown fields, and preserve unspecified fields.
Forward triggerChanged: false suppresses notifications while applying writes.
Add only missing constituents, use trait defaults for omitted fields, and never overwrite data of existing constituents.
Remove present constituent traits, tolerate absent constituents, and leave unrelated traits alone.
Require all constituents, compose with ordinary traits and other aspects, and update matching as constituent membership changes.

Use one merged data slot per directly supplied aspect, including an empty object for a tag-only aspect; ordinary tag parameters and Not modifiers contribute no data slots; retain surrounding data parameter order.
Write back changed existing fields to their constituent stores and detect changes per constituent using top-level strict inequality, not recursive value comparison.
changeDetection never still commits writes but suppresses change notifications.
For aspect queries, all non-never modes share the same branch and emit notifications for constituents detected as changed.
After the callback, skip writeback if the entity has been destroyed.
Dispatch detected constituent change notifications after processing the entity iteration, rather than during each callback.
For a single aspect within a mask generation, match entities missing at least one constituent, including none; update membership in both directions.
Require all constituents currently present and accept any recorded constituent data change; unchanged entities do not match.
Track incomplete-to-complete and complete-to-incomplete membership against existing modifier tracking history, including complete spawn and excluding removals from previously incomplete sets.
Expand an aspect into independently matching constituent alternatives: Or(aspect(A,B), C) is A OR B OR C.

onAdd gates constituent add callbacks on completeness; onRemove gates removals on the other constituents being present; onChange gates constituent change callbacks on completeness; callbacks receive the affected entity.
Return an unsubscribe function which removes all constituent subscriptions.
Notifications remain per constituent, so one aspect operation updating two constituents may invoke the aspect subscriber twice; do not coalesce to once per aspect operation.
Aspect instances participate distinctly in query hashing rather than being represented as ordinary constituent query parameters.
Combine constituents from multiple aspect Not parameters into a single notAll set; do not retain a separate negative predicate for each aspect.
checkAspectTrackingGroup returns the result for the first relevant generation; negative masks are evaluated separately per generation.
Function-valued schemas contribute no merged schema entries or field owners; their fields are not routed by aspect set/add through the field map.
Aspect queries continue working across world.reset through existing reset behavior.
For each constituent with supplied recognized fields, use the existing setTraitForTrait path, which emits change when triggerChanged is true even if supplied values equal existing values.
